summary: Frontend-only verification of (1) ShareSheet Instagram/Messenger direct deep-link path with paste-guide fallback on desktop web, and (2) '@' prefix on nickname + display_name rendering on own and external profiles. All static checks and interactive Playwright checks PASSED. No regressions observed.

change_1_sharesheet.other_share_options: PASS — share-whatsapp, share-telegram, share-twitter, share-facebook, share-email all present and still open URL (openUrl branch).

action_items: None — both changes verified as-implemented. Deep-link behavior on real iOS/Android devices can only be validated via native build; source and Info.plist declarations are correct.
critical_code_review_comments: ShareSheet: excellent structure — openDirect is well-documented, tryDeepLink returns false on web to force paste-guide fallback, clipboard write happens before any deep-link attempt so users are never left without the URL.
app.json: consider adding 'fb' scheme note in a comment — already present in whitelist, good.
user/[id].tsx: public-display-name is correctly conditional on profile.display_name being truthy — will not render an empty <Text> when unset.
seed_data_creation: None. Reused existing pre-verified users chat_a (id user_6e65e19525d5, display_name 'Mario Rossi') and chat_b (id user_16f709708760, no display_name).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth email/password UI is hidden (AUTH_EMAIL_ENABLED=false in /app/frontend/app/auth.tsx). To login as chat_a/chat_b on desktop web preview, POST /api/auth/login to obtain a JWT and inject into localStorage as key 'faide_token' with the token JSON.stringify-encoded, then navigate. Feud detail external share is opened via [data-testid='share-button'] (opens InAppShareSheet) → [data-testid='share-open-external'] (opens ShareSheet).
